study_metadata.protocol: Blind annotation - human labels assigned before viewing automated scorer output

samples.scenario_text: Senior engineer requesting 5 consecutive days of annual paid time off (PTO) planned for next month, submitted 21 days in advance.
samples.generated_reason: Annual leave request is within annual entitlement and complies with notice requirements.
samples.gold_policy_passage: All full-time employees accrue 20 days of Annual Leave per calendar year. Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least 2 weeks prior notice.
samples.human_notes: Exact section citation and accurate rationale matching 20 days PTO and 2-week notice rules.

samples.scenario_text: Employee submitting planned 4-day annual leave starting in 3 days without prior notice or manager pre-approval.
samples.cited_reference: Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least 2 weeks prior notice
samples.generated_reason: Planned leave of 4 days requires at least 14 days prior notice; received 3 days.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least 2 weeks prior notice and manager approval via the HR Portal.
samples.human_notes: Clear, grounded passage retrieval directly addressing the 2-week notice requirement.

samples.scenario_text: Employee taking 4 consecutive business days of sick leave but stating they will not provide a medical certificate.
samples.generated_reason: Medical absence of 4 consecutive business days requires an official medical certificate uploaded within 48 hours.
samples.gold_policy_passage: For any consecutive medical absence lasting 3 or more business days, an official medical certificate must be uploaded.
samples.human_notes: Accurate rule ID and correct explanation of the 3+ day medical certificate trigger.

samples.scenario_text: Employee requesting 4 days of paid bereavement leave for an extended family member (uncle).
samples.cited_reference: Up to 2 consecutive business days of paid leave are granted for extended family members
samples.generated_reason: Extended family bereavement leave capped at 2 days; requested 4 days.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Up to 2 consecutive business days of paid leave are granted for extended family members (grandparents, aunts, uncles).
samples.human_notes: Exact quote and mathematically grounded explanation of 2-day limit.

samples.scenario_text: Team lead purchasing $750 USD in cloud testing credits (Tier 1) with written approval from Direct Manager.
samples.cited_reference: FIN-POL-001 §2.1
samples.generated_reason: Tier 1 purchase within $1,000 threshold with manager approval.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Tier 1 (Up to $1,000 USD): Requires Direct Manager approval.
samples.human_notes: Correct tier classification and authorization reference.

samples.scenario_text: Procurement officer deliberately splitting a single $18,000 vendor contract into two $9,000 purchase orders.
samples.cited_reference: Intentionally splitting a single procurement order... to circumvent approval limits is strictly prohibited
samples.generated_reason: The action is an explicit split invoicing violation under the governing procurement policy.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Intentionally splitting a single procurement order, software license batch, or service invoice into multiple smaller invoices to circumvent approval limits is strictly prohibited.
samples.human_notes: Verbatim quote of the anti-structuring clause.

samples.scenario_text: Employee using corporate P-Card to buy personal cryptocurrency and luxury resort tickets.
samples.cited_reference: FIN-POL-001 §3.1
samples.generated_reason: Corporate P-Cards must never be used for personal expenses, cash advances, cryptocurrency, gambling, or luxury services.
samples.gold_policy_passage: P-Cards must never be used for personal expenses, personal cash advances, gambling, cryptocurrency transactions, or luxury/spa services.
samples.human_notes: Direct alignment with P-Card permissible usage guidelines.

samples.scenario_text: DevOps engineer requesting temporary 3-hour Break-Glass production DB access linked to active Jira P1 incident ticket #INC-8921.
samples.generated_reason: Break-glass JIT production access complies with 4-hour limit and has linked incident ticket.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Break-Glass Emergency Access: Temporary elevated production access must be requested via PAM portal with a linked incident ticket. Maximum grant duration is 4 hours.
samples.human_notes: Accurate reference to PAM break-glass conditions.

samples.scenario_text: Developer requesting permanent standing read/write admin access to production PostgreSQL database.
samples.cited_reference: Zero Standing Access: Direct read/write access to production databases is prohibited
samples.generated_reason: Standing permanent production access is forbidden under Zero Standing Access rules.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Zero Standing Access: Direct read/write access to production databases (SQL/NoSQL) and live cloud hosting infrastructure is prohibited for standard development roles.
samples.human_notes: Exact quote of the Zero Standing Access clause.

samples.scenario_text: Release manager who holds production deployment authority requesting additional authority to approve their own PRs.
samples.generated_reason: Separation of Duties violation: no single individual may hold both code deployment and production release approval authority.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Dual Custody & Separation of Duties: No single individual may hold both software code deployment privileges and production release approval authority.
samples.human_notes: Accurate identification of dual custody / SoD violation.

samples.scenario_text: System administrator requesting IAM root admin account protected solely by standard SMS-based text message OTP.
samples.cited_reference: SMS-based OTP is strictly prohibited as a standalone authentication factor for privileged access
samples.generated_reason: Privileged administrator roles require FIDO2 hardware keys; SMS OTP is prohibited.
samples.gold_policy_passage: SMS-based OTP is strictly prohibited as a standalone authentication factor for privileged access.
samples.human_notes: Direct quote of privileged MFA prohibition on SMS OTP.

samples.scenario_text: Sales director claiming $160 USD per attendee for a lavish 2-person dinner with prospective clients.
samples.cited_reference: FIN-POL-001 §5.1
samples.generated_reason: Client dining expense ($160/attendee) exceeds the maximum limit of $100 USD per attendee.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Business meals hosted for prospective or active clients are reimbursable up to $100 USD per attendee.
samples.human_notes: Accurate threshold citation ($100 per attendee cap).

samples.scenario_text: Employee requesting 2 days of annual leave submitted 1 day in advance.
samples.cited_reference: Employees are granted 10 days of paid Sick Leave annually.
samples.generated_reason: Leave request evaluated against sick leave policy.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Short-duration planned leave (1-2 business days) must be submitted at least 48 hours in advance via the HR Portal.
samples.human_notes: Citation is about SICK leave policy, but scenario is about ANNUAL leave short-notice. Wrong policy section cited.

samples.scenario_text: Manager purchasing $8,500 USD software subscription with only Direct Manager approval.
samples.cited_reference: Tier 1 (Up to $1,000 USD): Requires Direct Manager approval.
samples.generated_reason: Purchase has manager approval and complies with Tier 1 requirements.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Tier 2 ($1,001 to $10,000 USD): Requires Direct Manager and Department Head (Director) approval.
samples.human_notes: Citation cites Tier 1 ($1,000 limit) but the purchase is $8,500 which falls under Tier 2. Wrong tier cited, leading to incorrect approval.

samples.scenario_text: Junior developer requesting read-only staging environment access for testing purposes.
samples.cited_reference: Zero Standing Access: Direct read/write access to production databases is prohibited.
samples.generated_reason: Access request blocked under Zero Standing Access policy.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Standard development and staging environments are accessible via role-based access control with Direct Manager authorization.
samples.human_notes: Citation references PRODUCTION access restrictions but the request is for STAGING environment. Wrong scope applied; staging access has different rules.

samples.scenario_text: New employee (30 days tenure) claiming $250 ergonomic home office setup allowance with receipts.
samples.cited_reference: All expense claims must be filed within 30 calendar days.
samples.generated_reason: Expense claim is within the 30-day filing window.
samples.gold_policy_passage: A one-time Ergonomic Home Office Setup Stipend of up to $300 USD is available within the first 90 days of employment.
samples.human_notes: Citation references the FILING DEADLINE rule, not the ERGONOMIC STIPEND rule. The 30-day reference is about expense submission timing, not about the stipend eligibility window (90 days).

samples.scenario_text: Employee submitting $45 taxi receipt for airport transfer during business travel.
samples.cited_reference: Business meals hosted for prospective or active clients are reimbursable up to $100 USD per attendee.
samples.generated_reason: Travel expense is within reimbursement limits.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Ground transportation (taxi, rideshare) receipts are reimbursable at actual cost for business travel.
samples.human_notes: Citation references CLIENT DINING reimbursement limits, not GROUND TRANSPORTATION policy. Completely wrong policy section.

samples.scenario_text: Contractor requesting temporary VPN access for 2-week project engagement with signed NDA.
samples.cited_reference: All machine credentials and API tokens must be rotated at least every 90 calendar days.
samples.generated_reason: Contractor access reviewed against credential rotation policy.
samples.gold_policy_passage: External contractors and temporary staff access requires sponsor (hiring manager) attestation, signed NDA, and time-limited credentials with automatic expiry.
samples.human_notes: Citation references API TOKEN ROTATION policy, not CONTRACTOR ACCESS provisioning. Different section entirely; the rotation SLA is irrelevant to the VPN access request.

samples.scenario_text: Full-time software engineer accepting paid weekend contracting work for a commercial fintech startup.
samples.cited_reference: Full-time employees are strictly prohibited from engaging in commercial secondary employment
samples.generated_reason: Commercial moonlighting without VP/HR approval violates enterprise ethics.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Full-time employees are strictly prohibited from engaging in commercial secondary employment, consulting contracts, or board advisories.
samples.human_notes: Citation is a partial but accurate quote of the moonlighting prohibition. Sufficient for grounding.

samples.scenario_text: Vendor demanding a 60% upfront advance payment ($30,000 USD) on a custom consulting engagement without bank guarantee.
samples.cited_reference: Advance payments to suppliers exceeding 30% of total contract value are prohibited
samples.generated_reason: Advance payment of 60% exceeds the allowable 30% threshold without a bank guarantee.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Advance payments to suppliers exceeding 30% of total contract value are prohibited unless backed by a performance bank guarantee.
samples.human_notes: Accurate citation of the 30% advance ceiling. Partial quote but captures the essential rule.

samples.scenario_text: Database administrator reviewing an internal service account API key active for 115 days without rotation.
samples.generated_reason: API secret has not been rotated in 115 days (mandatory rotation SLA is 90 calendar days).
samples.gold_policy_passage: All machine credentials and API tokens must be stored in centralized Enterprise Vaults and rotated at least every 90 calendar days.
samples.human_notes: Accurate 90-day SLA citation. Rule ID is correct.

samples.scenario_text: Employee buying a $2,200 MacBook Pro directly on personal credit card and submitting an expense reimbursement claim.
samples.cited_reference: All laptops, monitors, servers, and telecommunication hardware must be procured exclusively via Centralized IT Procurement
samples.generated_reason: Individual purchases of computing hardware via expense reimbursement are strictly prohibited.
samples.gold_policy_passage: All laptops, monitors, servers, and telecommunication hardware must be procured exclusively via Centralized IT Procurement. Individual employee purchases via reimbursement are strictly prohibited.
samples.human_notes: Accurate citation of IT centralized hardware procurement rule.

samples.scenario_text: Employee copying confidential customer databases to an unencrypted personal USB flash drive to work from home.
samples.cited_reference: Downloading customer PII or confidential enterprise databases to unencrypted USB drives... is strictly prohibited
samples.generated_reason: Exporting sensitive customer records to unencrypted personal storage is an absolute security violation.
samples.gold_policy_passage: Downloading customer PII or confidential enterprise databases to unencrypted USB drives, personal devices, or unauthorized external cloud storage is strictly prohibited.
samples.human_notes: Flawless citation on removable media and data export bans.

samples.scenario_text: Employee submitting an expense claim incurred 70 calendar days ago along with valid original receipts.
samples.generated_reason: Expense claim submitted after 70 days; claims older than 60 days are automatically rejected.
samples.gold_policy_passage: All expense claims must be filed within 30 calendar days. Claims older than 60 days will be rejected automatically.
samples.human_notes: Accurately references the 60-day auto-rejection threshold.
